title: Impact of Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti on dengue incidence in endemic regions: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
abstract: Dengue remains a major public health challenge in endemic regions, and conventional vector-control strategies have shown limited long-term effectiveness. The release of Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes has emerged as a novel biocontrol strategy to reduce dengue transmission. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis to evaluate the effectiveness of Wolbachia deployments in reducing dengue incidence. We searched PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library until 30 April 2025 for randomized controlled trials and quasi-experimental studies conducted in dengue-endemic settings. Population-level effectiveness was assessed using pooled incidence rate ratios (IRRs), and individual-level protective efficacy using pooled odds ratios (ORs). Random-effects meta-analysis with restricted maximum likelihood with Hartung-Knapp adjustment was applied. Subgroup analyses examined geographic region and deployment coverage. Nine studies involving >8 million individuals were included. Wolbachia deployment was associated with a substantial reduction in dengue incidence (pooled IRR 0.15, 95% CI 0.05-0.39), corresponding to an estimated 85% reduction. Full-area deployments demonstrated greater reductions (IRR 0.046, 95% CI 0.038-0.055) than partial-area deployments (IRR 0.22, 95% CI 0.07-0.74). Exploratory individual-level analyses yielded a pooled OR of 0.29 (95% CI 0.01-8.41) with substantial heterogeneity (I2 = 86.5%).
journal: Transactions of the Royal Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis assessed the effectiveness of Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti deployments in reducing dengue incidence across endemic regions. Using pooled incidence rate ratios from nine studies (>8 million individuals), the intervention demonstrated a substantial reduction in dengue incidence (pooled IRR 0.15, 85% reduction), with full-area deployments outperforming partial deployments. title: Knowledge, Attitudes and Practices (KAP) on Dengue Fever in Burkina Faso: Findings from the national household survey in Burkina Faso.
abstract: Abstract Background Dengue fever is an emerging public health concern in Burkina Faso, with increasing outbreaks and data gaps in population awareness. This study assessed knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) related to dengue fever in all health regions of the country. Methodology/Principal Findings A nationwide cross-sectional household survey was conducted in May 2022 using a stratified two-stage cluster sampling design. One rural and one urban area were selected per region. Heads of households or their representatives were interviewed using a structured questionnaire. Data were collected electronically and analyzed using Stata. A total of 1,568 participants were enrolled (52.0% male; 48.0% female). Overall, 66.3% had heard of dengue, with higher awareness in urban than rural areas. Only 49.0% correctly identified mosquito bites as the mode of transmission, and 29.9% did not know what dengue is. Most respondents (88.3%) stated that dengue can affect everyone. Regarding prevention, 80.2% reported sleeping under a mosquito net, 49.0% eliminated stagnant water, and 45.4% used mosquito repellents. In practice, 67.6% consistently slept under mosquito nets and 82.6% used repellents. Almost all respondents (98.6%) reported that they would consult a health professional if they had symptoms of dengue. However, knowledge about treatment and vaccination was limited, with 46.5% and 56.6% respectively reporting not knowing whether drugs or vaccines exist. Conclusions/Significance This study highlights moderate awareness but substantial knowledge gaps and urban–rural disparities in dengue-related KAP in Burkina Faso. Strengthening community-based education and integrated vector control strategies is essential to improve prevention and reduce dengue transmission. Author Summary Dengue fever is a mosquito-borne disease that is spreading in many parts of the world, including West Africa. In Burkina Faso, outbreaks have been reported in recent years, but little is known about what communities understand about the disease or how they protect themselves. In this study, we conducted a nationwide household survey covering all health regions of the country to explore people’s knowledge, perceptions, and prevention practices related to dengue. We found that while many people had heard about dengue, important gaps remain. A significant proportion did not know how the disease is transmitted or whether treatments or vaccines exist. Preventive actions such as sleeping under mosquito nets and removing standing water were reported, but these practices were not consistent everywhere, especially between urban and rural areas. Encouragingly, almost all respondents said they would seek care from a health professional if they developed symptoms. Our work provides the first national picture of community awareness and behaviors related to dengue in Burkina Faso. These findings highlight the need for strengthened health education and community engagement to improve prevention and support ongoing efforts to control mosquito-borne diseases.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热 是布基纳法索的一个新兴公共卫生问题,暴发 和人口意识方面的数据差距不断增加。本研究旨在评估所有卫生区域与 登革热 相关的知识、态度和实践 (KAP)。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2022 年 5 月,采用分层两阶段整群抽样设计进行了全国横断面住户调查。每个地区选择 1 个农村地区和 1 个城市地区。共有 1,568 名参与者参加(52.0% 男性;48.0% 女性)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用结构化调查问卷对户主或其代表进行了访谈。数据以电子方式收集并使用 Stata 进行分析。该研究在全国范围内进行了家庭调查,覆盖全国所有卫生区域,以了解人们对登革热的相关知识、看法和预防做法。
elements_zh.main_results: 总体而言,66.3%的人听说过登革热,城市知晓率高于农村。只有49.0%的人正确识别蚊虫叮咬为传播的模式,29.9%的人不知道什么是登革热。据报道,人们采取了睡在蚊帐下和清除积水等预防措施,但这些做法并非各地都一致,特别是在城市和农村地区之间。几乎所有受访者(98.6%)表示,如果出现症状,他们会寻求医疗专业人员的护理。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了布基纳法索对登革热相关 KAP 的认识中等,但存在巨大的知识差距和城乡差异。它提供了布基纳法索与登革热相关的社区意识和行为的第一张全国图片。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调需要加强健康教育和社区参与,以改善预防并支持控制蚊媒疾病的持续努力。该研究为设计有针对性的公共卫生干预措施提供了重要见解,以解决登革热相关实践中的知识差距和差异。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横截面设计的限制,无法确定因果关系。由于依赖自我报告的数据以及城乡差异可能影响普遍性,因此证据强度中等。

title: Integrating Microfluidics Chips into Vector-Borne Disease Surveillance: Technological Breakthroughs and Persistent Hurdles.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Vector-borne diseases (VBDs), such as malaria, dengue, and Zika virus infections, remain a critical global health burden, particularly in resource-limited regions. Conventional diagnostic methods, including microscopy, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays, and polymerase chain reaction, face significant limitations due to their reliance on centralized laboratories, lengthy processing times, and high operational costs, hindering timely disease management in remote or underserved areas. OBJECTIVE: Microfluidic diagnostics have emerged as a transformative solution, offering portability, system integration, and high sensitivity through miniaturized fluidic control and multiplexed detection capabilities. These devices enable rapid, on-site diagnosis by combining sample preparation, target amplification, and signal readout into a single chip, aligning with the growing demand for point-of-care testing. METHODS: This review was conducted following a systematic literature search of PubMed, Web of Science, and Scopus databases from January 2010 to June 2026. Search terms included combinations of "microfluidic," "lab-on-a-chip," "point-of-care," "vector-borne disease," "malaria," "dengue," "Zika," "West Nile virus," "Lyme disease," and "CRISPR." Inclusion criteria were (1) peer-reviewed articles reporting microfluidic chip applications for VBD pathogen detection or vector surveillance; (2) studies describing field-deployable or clinically validated platforms; and (3) publications in English. Exclusion criteria included purely theoretical modeling studies without experimental validation and nonchip-based microfluidic systems. A total of 87 studies were selected for qualitative synthesis after title/abstract screening and full-text evaluation. We critically evaluate real-world application scenarios, including field deployments for malaria surveillance in Uganda and outbreak responses to arboviral infections in Brazil and Southeast Asia, while addressing persistent translational barriers such as manufacturing standardization, sample pretreatment complexity, and cost-effectiveness. RESULTS: Key findings demonstrate the successful integration of sample-to-answer workflows on miniaturized platforms, achieving significant reductions in detection time and operational dependencies compared with conventional laboratory methods. Critical challenges identified include manufacturing scalability for resource-limited settings, complex sample pretreatment requirements, and the pressing need for cost reduction to ensure sustainable deployment in endemic regions. CONCLUSION: This review aims to explore emerging integration strategies beyond conventional diagnostics, focusing on approaches such as CRISPR-based assays, artificial intelligence-driven image analysis, and scalable manufacturing processes to strengthen global VBD control networks and improve clinical outcomes in underserved populations. CONCLUSION: This review aims to explore emerging integration strategies beyond conventional diagnostics, focusing on approaches such as CRISPR-based assays, simplified image analysis, and scalable manufacturing processes to strengthen global VBD control networks and improve clinical outcomes in underserved populations. Specific recommendations for phased deployment in endemic regions, including pilot beta-testing programs and technology transfer partnerships, are proposed to accelerate translational impact.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热等 媒介 传播疾病给全球带来了巨大的健康负担,特别是在资源有限的环境中,传统诊断在及时性、便携性和成本方面面临严重限制。该研究强调需要创新的诊断方法来克服这些障碍并实现有效的疾病管理。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本系统综述综合了 2010 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月发表的有关 媒介 传播疾病病原体检测的微流控芯片应用和 媒介 监测 的同行评审文献。纳入的研究报告了用于检测病原体(包括 登革病毒)的可现场部署或临床验证的微流控平台。
elements_zh.methods: 使用与微流体、即时检测和 Z​​XQTERMAEQXZ 传播疾病相关的目标术语在 PubMed、Web of Science 和 Scopus 中进行了系统的文献检索。纳入标准需要对基于微流控芯片的检测平台进行实验验证,而排除标准则删除了纯粹的理论建模研究和非基于芯片的微流控系统。
elements_zh.main_results: 该审查确定了 87 项研究,这些研究证明了在小型化微流体平台上成功集成了样本到答案工作流程,用于 媒介 传播的疾病检测,与传统实验室方法相比,显着减少了检测时间和操作依赖性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证据,表明微流体诊断可以通过集成的样品制备、扩增和检测实现快速现场 诊断,从而改变 媒介 传播疾病的现场检测。新颖之处在于综合现实世界的应用场景并识别特定于现场部署的转化障碍。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持微流体诊断通过减少诊断延迟和运营成本来加强流行地区登革热和其他虫媒病毒感染的 监测 和临床管理的潜力。审查提出了分阶段部署战略和技术转让伙伴关系,以加速实际实施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于缺乏针对登革热特定平台的定量性能指标以及依赖于异质性研究的定性综合,证据基础受到限制。由于已确定的转化障碍(包括制造可扩展性、样品预处理复杂性和成本效益问题),证据的强度是中等的。

abstract_zh: 背景:媒介 传播的疾病(VBD),如疟疾、登革热和寨卡病毒感染,仍然是全球严重的健康负担,特别是在资源有限的地区。传统的诊断方法,包括显微镜检查、酶联免疫吸附测定和聚合酶链反应,由于依赖集中实验室、处理时间长和运营成本高而面临很大的局限性,阻碍了偏远或服务不足地区的及时疾病管理。目标:微流控诊断已成为一种变革性解决方案,通过小型化流体控制和多重检测功能提供便携性、系统集成和高灵敏度。这些设备通过将样品制备、目标放大和信号读出结合到单个芯片中,实现快速现场 诊断,满足了对即时检测不断增长的需求。方法:本综述是在对 2010 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月期间 PubMed、Web of Science 和 Scopus 数据库进行系统文献检索后进行的。检索词包括“微流体”、“芯片实验室”、“护理点”、“媒介 传播疾病”、“疟疾”、“登革热”、“寨卡”、“西尼罗河病毒”、“莱姆病”、和“CRISPR”。纳入标准为(1)同行评审的文章,报告微流控芯片在VBD病原体检测中的应用或媒介 监测;(2) 描述可现场部署或经过临床验证的平台的研究;(3) 英文出版物。排除标准包括未经实验验证的纯理论建模研究和基于非芯片的微流体系统。经过标题/摘要筛选和全文评估后,总共选择了 87 项研究进行定性综合。我们严格评估现实世界的应用场景,包括乌干达疟疾 监测 的现场部署和巴西和东南亚 暴发 对虫媒病毒感染的反应,同时解决持续存在的转化障碍,例如制造标准化、样品预处理复杂性和成本效益。结果:主要研究结果表明,与传统实验室方法相比,在小型化平台上成功集成了样本到答案工作流程,显着减少了检测时间和操作依赖性。确定的关键挑战包括资源有限环境下的制造可扩展性、复杂的样品预处理要求以及降低成本以确保在流行地区可持续部署的迫切需要。结论:本综述旨在探索传统诊断之外的新兴整合策略,重点关注基于 CRISPR 的检测、人工智能驱动的图像分析和可扩展的制造工艺等方法,以加强全球 VBD 控制网络并改善服务不足人群的临床结果。结论:本综述旨在探索传统诊断之外的新兴整合策略,重点关注基于 CRISPR 的检测、简化的图像分析和可扩展的制造工艺等方法,以加强全球 VBD 控制网络并改善服务不足人群的临床结果。提出了在流行地区分阶段部署的具体建议,包括试点测试计划和技术转让伙伴关系,以加速转化影响。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热等 媒介 传播疾病给全球带来了巨大的健康负担,特别是在资源有限的环境中,传统诊断在及时性、便携性和成本方面面临严重限制。该研究强调需要创新的诊断方法来克服这些障碍并实现有效的疾病管理。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本系统综述综合了 2010 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月发表的有关 媒介 传播疾病病原体检测的微流控芯片应用和 媒介 监测 的同行评审文献。纳入的研究报告了用于检测病原体(包括 登革病毒)的可现场部署或临床验证的微流控平台。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用与微流体、即时检测和 Z​​XQTERMAEQXZ 传播疾病相关的目标术语在 PubMed、Web of Science 和 Scopus 中进行了系统的文献检索。纳入标准需要对基于微流控芯片的检测平台进行实验验证,而排除标准则删除了纯粹的理论建模研究和非基于芯片的微流控系统。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该审查确定了 87 项研究,这些研究证明了在小型化微流体平台上成功集成了样本到答案工作流程,用于 媒介 传播的疾病检测,与传统实验室方法相比,显着减少了检测时间和操作依赖性。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证据,表明微流体诊断可以通过集成的样品制备、扩增和检测实现快速现场 诊断,从而改变 媒介 传播疾病的现场检测。新颖之处在于综合现实世界的应用场景并识别特定于现场部署的转化障碍。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持微流体诊断通过减少诊断延迟和运营成本来加强流行地区登革热和其他虫媒病毒感染的 监测 和临床管理的潜力。审查提出了分阶段部署战略和技术转让伙伴关系,以加速实际实施。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于缺乏针对登革热特定平台的定量性能指标以及依赖于异质性研究的定性综合,证据基础受到限制。由于已确定的转化障碍(包括制造可扩展性、样品预处理复杂性和成本效益问题),证据的强度是中等的。

title: Year-Round Dengue Surveillance in Tangerang Regency, Indonesia (2024): Clinical and Virological Features with Biomarker Evaluation.
abstract: Dengue remains a major public health concern in Indonesia. This study aimed to describe the epidemiology, clinical characteristics, immune responses, and genotype characterization of dengue virus (DENV) infections in Tangerang Regency, Indonesia. A year-round prospective surveillance was conducted from January 2024-January 2025 at a district hospital and two primary health centers. Febrile patients aged ≥4 years were tested using dengue NS1, IgM/IgG rapid tests, ELISA, and RT-PCR, and serum biomarkers (angiopoietin-2, IL-6, ferritin, sCD163) were quantified. Of 404 participants, 240 (59.4%) had confirmed dengue. Among RT-PCR-serotyped cases (n=192), the distribution was DENV-2 63/192 (32.8%), DENV-1 60/192 (31.3%), DENV-3 47/192 (24.5%), and DENV-4 22/192 (11.5%). Among hospitalized dengue cases (n=144), secondary infection (131/144, 91.0%) was associated with severe disease (adjusted OR=10.25; 95% CI: 1.71-197.90, p=0.034). Biomarker levels were elevated in dengue cases but did not discriminate severity, indicating the need for validation in larger cohorts using standardized definitions. Sequencing identified DENV-1 genotypes I and IV, DENV-2 Cosmopolitan, DENV-3 genotype I, and DENV-4 genotype IIa; one DENV-4 isolate carried an EDIII E384 D→H substitution warranting further investigation. Continued genomic surveillance and vaccine development that induces balanced, serotype-specific immunity are needed to support national and global dengue control.

analysis.summary_en: This study conducted year-round dengue surveillance in Tangerang Regency, Indonesia, from January 2024 to January 2025, focusing on the epidemiology, clinical characteristics, immune responses, and genotype distribution of dengue virus (DENV) infections. The findings highlight the importance of continued genomic surveillance and the development of vaccines that induce balanced, serotype-specific immunity. However, the study's reliance on a limited number of healthcare facilities may affect its generalizability, and the evidence is considered moderate in strength.

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究深入了解了 登革病毒 感染的血清型分布和临床特征,强调了继发感染与严重疾病之间的关联。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为 监测 策略提供信息,并强调开发 疫苗 的必要性,以诱导平衡的血清型特异性免疫来支持登革热控制。

title: CORRELATION BETWEEN NEUTROPHIL LYMPHOCYTE RATIO, PLATELET LYMPHOCYTE RATIO AND DENGUE FEVER IN CHILDREN-A CROSS-SECTIONAL STUDY.
abstract: Dengue is a re-emerging tropical disease transmitted by mosquitoes. This cross-sectional study was conducted in the Department of Paediatrics of a tertiary care centre in South India over two years. Children and adolescents aged 0-15 years who presented with fever and were confirmed to have dengue by serological tests were included in this study. Blood was collected and sent for complete blood count (CBC) on day 3 of illness. Neutrophil-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) and platelet-lymphocyte ratio (PLR) were derived. The sensitivity of NLR and PLR was 68.4% and 96.8% respectively, while the specificity of NLR and PLR were 41.7% and 66.7% respectively. Although PLR was found to have higher sensitivity and specificity, NLR was found to have an increased positive predictive value. The platelet-lymphocyte ratio demonstrates superiority by overall accuracy, specificity, and sensitivity, proving to be a more effective marker for identifying severe dengue cases. NLR and PLR demonstrated a strong positive correlation (r = 0.83, p <0.001). The clinical utility of these ratios has been extensively studied in other diseases, such as sepsis and COVID-19, especially in adults, but has been underutilized in children due to the lack of knowledge and limited research.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that although PLR had higher sensitivity and specificity, NLR showed an increased positive predictive value. This suggests that NLR may be more useful in identifying severe dengue cases in children.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨儿童中性粒细胞-淋巴细胞比值(NLR)和血小板-淋巴细胞比值(PLR)与登革热之间的相关性,因为这些比值已在其他疾病中进行了研究,但在儿科登革热病例中的研究还不够充分。这项研究的动机是需要确定有效的生物标志物以早期检测儿童登革热。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 印度南部一家三级护理中心的儿科进行了一项为期两年的横断面研究。该研究纳入了出现发烧症状并经血清学检测证实患有登革热的0-15岁儿童和青少年。
elements_zh.methods: 在患病第 3 天收集血样并进行全血细胞计数 (CBC) 分析。NLR 和 PLR 根据 CBC 结果计算。该研究使用这些比率来评估它们作为儿童 登革热 生物标志物的潜力。
elements_zh.main_results: NLR 和 PLR 显示出很强的正相关性(r = 0.83,p < 0.001)。NLR和PLR的敏感性分别为68.4%和96.8%,NLR和PLR的特异性分别为41.7%和66.7%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,虽然PLR具有更高的敏感性和特异性,但NLR表现出更高的阳性预测价值。这表明 NLR 在识别儿童 重症登革热 病例方面可能更有用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于开发更有效的生物标志物,用于儿童 重症登革热 的早期检测和风险评估,从而有可能改善临床决策和公共卫生 监测。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横截面设计的限制,无法确定因果关系。由于依赖血清学确认且缺乏纵向数据,证据强度中等。

title_zh: 儿童中性粒细胞淋巴细胞比率、血小板淋巴细胞比率和 登革热 之间的相关性 - 横断面研究。
source_body_en: Dengue is a re-emerging tropical disease transmitted by mosquitoes. This cross-sectional study was conducted in the Department of Paediatrics of a tertiary care centre in South India over two years. NLR and PLR demonstrated a strong positive correlation (r = 0.83, p <0.001). abstract_zh: 登革热是一种重新出现的由蚊子传播的热带疾病。这项横断面研究是在印度南部一家三级护理中心的儿科进行的,历时两年多。本研究纳入了出现发烧症状并经血清学检测证实患有登革热的0-15岁儿童和青少年。在患病第 3 天采集血液并送去进行全血细胞计数 (CBC)。得出中性粒细胞-淋巴细胞比率(NLR)和血小板-淋巴细胞比率(PLR)。NLR和PLR的敏感性分别为68.4%和96.8%,NLR和PLR的特异性分别为41.7%和66.7%。尽管发现 PLR 具有更高的敏感性和特异性,但发现 NLR 具有更高的阳性预测价值。血小板-淋巴细胞比率在总体准确性、特异性和敏感性方面表现出优越性,被证明是识别 重症登革热 病例的更有效标记。NLR 和 PLR 显示出很强的正相关性(r = 0.83,p <0.001)。这些比率的临床效用已在脓毒症和 COVID-19 等其他疾病中得到了广泛研究,尤其是在成人中,但由于缺乏知识和研究有限,在儿童中尚未得到充分利用。

title: Evaluation of inactivated and live attenuated, tetravalent dengue vaccine prime-boost strategies in a randomized, open-label, phase I study: implications for understanding immune correlates of protection.
abstract: UNLABELLED: Vaccines that elicit balanced, protective immunity to all four dengue virus (DENV) types are needed to reduce the global burden of dengue disease. Achieving this goal has been a challenge for dengue vaccine developers, particularly when immunizing dengue immunologically naïve individuals. In this randomized, phase I, open-label study of 40 healthy adults, we evaluated a heterologous, tetravalent purified inactivated vaccine (PIV) prime and a tetravalent live attenuated vaccine (LAV) boost. We compared a 0, 90 day PIV/LAV prime-boost schedule to a 0, 180 day schedule. These two PIV/LAV regimens elicited similar, high, and balanced cellular and humoral immune responses to DENV 1-4, although the condensed schedule was associated with more severe adverse events. In a subsequent clinical trial [K. Friberg, et al., Lancet Infect Dis 24:896-908, 2024, https://doi.org/10.1016/S1473-3099(24)00100-2], the PIV/LAV vaccinees were challenged with DENV-1 and most were unprotected and experienced more pronounced dengue fever-like illness than unvaccinated controls. These outcomes underscore critical gaps in our understanding of mechanistic correlates of dengue vaccine-mediated protection and disease risk. IMPORTANCE: Dengue vaccine research and development has been complicated by several factors, including an incomplete understanding of immunologic correlates of protection and immune-mediated risk of severe disease. High and balanced immunity elicited by the tetravalent purified inactivated vaccine (PIV)/live attenuated vaccine (LAV) prime-boost vaccine strategy was predicted to provide protection from dengue virus type 1 (DENV-1) challenge in a subsequent clinical study, but vaccinees were unprotected and had an unexpected increase in symptom severity compared to unvaccinated controls. Evidence of exposure to a specific DENV type by viral genome detection (e.g., by quantitative RT-PCR) in acute samples or measurement of post-exposure, type-specific antibody responses (e.g., by serum antibody depletion) are known correlates of protection. However, current methods of measuring type-specific antibody are not ideal for evaluating groups of vaccinees, even in relatively small clinical trials. Newer, high-throughput methods of determining DENV type-specific immune responses and discovery of other correlates of protection are needed to more reliably evaluate dengue vaccine candidates.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated two prime-boost vaccination strategies for a tetravalent dengue vaccine in 40 healthy adults. The researchers compared a 0, 90 day schedule of purified inactivated vaccine (PIV) and live attenuated vaccine (LAV) with a 0, 180 day schedule. Both regimens elicited high and balanced immune responses, but the shorter schedule was linked to more severe adverse events. In a follow-up trial, vaccinated individuals were unprotected and experienced more severe dengue-like symptoms compared to unvaccinated controls. These results highlight the need for better understanding of immune correlates of protection and improved methods for evaluating vaccine efficacy. The study's findings have implications for vaccine development and the design of future trials, but the evidence is limited by the small sample size and the challenges in measuring immune responses accurately.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: This study was a randomized, phase I, open-label trial involving 40 healthy adults. The study evaluated a heterologous, tetravalent purified inactivated vaccine (PIV) prime and a tetravalent live attenuated vaccine (LAV) boost regimen. The researchers compared two schedules: 0, 90 day and 0, 180 day.
elements_zh.methods: 该研究通过定量 RT-PCR 在急性样本中使用病毒 基因组 检测,并使用血清抗体消耗测量暴露后的类型特异性抗体反应。这些方法是已知的保护相关方法。然而,目前测量类型特异性抗体的方法对于在小型临床试验中评估 疫苗 并不理想。
elements_zh.main_results: 两种 PIV/LAV 方案引发与 DENV 1-4 类似、高且平衡的细胞和体液 免疫应答。然而,浓缩的 0 天、90 天时间表与更严重的不良事件相关。在随后的临床试验中,与未接种疫苗的对照组相比,疫苗 没有受到保护,并且经历了更明显的 登革热 样疾病。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果凸显了在理解登革热 疫苗 介导的保护和疾病风险的机制相关性方面的关键差距。该研究强调需要改进方法来评估 免疫应答 并确定保护的相关性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究结果强调了了解保护的免疫相关性以及与不同 疫苗接种 方案相关的潜在风险的重要性,为开发更有效的登革热 疫苗 提供了信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的样本量较小以及对特定 免疫应答 测量的依赖可能会限制普遍性。证据是中等的,因为结果是基于单次试验和随后的临床挑战,所使用的测量技术存在一些局限性。

title_zh: 在随机、开放标签、I 期研究中评估灭活和减毒活四价登革热 疫苗 初免加强策略:对了解保护的免疫相关性的影响。
source_body_en: UNLABELLED: Vaccines that elicit balanced, protective immunity to all four dengue virus (DENV) types are needed to reduce the global burden of dengue disease. Achieving this goal has been a challenge for dengue vaccine developers, particularly when immunizing dengue immunologically naïve individuals. In this randomized, phase I, open-label study of 40 healthy adults, we evaluated a heterologous, tetravalent purified inactivated vaccine (PIV) prime and a tetravalent live attenuated vaccine (LAV) boost. We compared a 0, 90 day PIV/LAV prime-boost schedule to a 0, 180 day schedule. These two PIV/LAV regimens elicited similar, high, and balanced cellular and humoral immune responses to DENV 1-4, although the condensed schedule was associated with more severe adverse events. In a subsequent clinical trial [K. Friberg, et al., Lancet Infect Dis 24:896-908, 2024, https://doi.org/10.1016/S1473-3099(24)00100-2], the PIV/LAV vaccinees were challenged with DENV-1 and most were unprotected and experienced more pronounced dengue fever-like illness than unvaccinated controls. These outcomes underscore critical gaps in our understanding of mechanistic correlates of dengue vaccine-mediated protection and disease risk. IMPORTANCE: Dengue vaccine research and development has been complicated by several factors, including an incomplete understanding of immunologic correlates of protection and immune-mediated risk of severe disease. High and balanced immunity elicited by the tetravalent purified inactivated vaccine (PIV)/live attenuated vaccine (LAV) prime-boost vaccine strategy was predicted to provide protection from dengue virus type 1 (DENV-1) challenge in a subsequent clinical study, but vaccinees were unprotected and had an unexpected increase in symptom severity compared to unvaccinated controls. Evidence of exposure to a specific DENV type by viral genome detection (e.g., by quantitative RT-PCR) in acute samples or measurement of post-exposure, type-specific antibody responses (e.g., by serum antibody depletion) are known correlates of protection. However, current methods of measuring type-specific antibody are not ideal for evaluating groups of vaccinees, even in relatively small clinical trials. Newer, high-throughput methods of determining DENV type-specific immune responses and discovery of other correlates of protection are needed to more reliably evaluate dengue vaccine candidates.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 需要针对所有四种 登革病毒 (DENV) 类型的登革热 疫苗 产生平衡免疫力,以减轻登革热疾病的全球负担。实现这一目标对于登革热 疫苗 开发人员来说是一个挑战,特别是在对登革热免疫学上未接触过的个体进行免疫接种时。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究通过定量 RT-PCR 在急性样本中使用病毒 基因组 检测,并使用血清抗体消耗测量暴露后的类型特异性抗体反应。这些方法是已知的保护相关方法。然而,目前测量类型特异性抗体的方法对于在小型临床试验中评估 疫苗 并不理想。
analysis_zh.main_results: 两种 PIV/LAV 方案引发与 DENV 1-4 类似、高且平衡的细胞和体液 免疫应答。然而,浓缩的 0 天、90 天时间表与更严重的不良事件相关。在随后的临床试验中,与未接种疫苗的对照组相比,疫苗 没有受到保护,并且经历了更明显的 登革热 样疾病。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果凸显了在理解登革热 疫苗 介导的保护和疾病风险的机制相关性方面的关键差距。该研究强调需要改进方法来评估 免疫应答 并确定保护的相关性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究结果强调了了解保护的免疫相关性以及与不同 疫苗接种 方案相关的潜在风险的重要性,为开发更有效的登革热 疫苗 提供了信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的样本量较小以及对特定 免疫应答 测量的依赖可能会限制普遍性。证据是中等的,因为结果是基于单次试验和随后的临床挑战,所使用的测量技术存在一些局限性。

title: The spatial structure of dengue transmission in Kamphaeng Phet Thailand.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito transmitted arbovirus that represents a severe threat to global populations. The four serotypes of DENV often circulate endemically resulting in many discrete but overlapping transmission chains in space and time, effectively hiding the underlying patterns of transmission, and longer term consequences on local population immunity. Here we combined serotyped case data with sequence data from a single setting over 25 years to characterise the spatial dependence between cases, the number of distinct transmission chains circulating at any time and whether community transmission was followed by serotype-specific local herd immunity. METHODOLOGY/PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: In this study, we combined geolocated case data (N = 7,487) from individuals that presented at a provincial hospital in Kamphaeng Phet Province, Thailand alongside a subset of the sequences of the viruses (N = 302) that infected them. We estimated the spatial dependence between case pairs over different temporal and spatial windows, using both serotype and sequence data, and used logistic regression to identify whether host population size or epidemic size were correlated with viral diversity. We found there was spatial dependence between cases at up to 5 km, resulting in localised serotype-specific patterns of immunity in subsequent years. Within a 78.5 km2 area there were 9.6 distinct transmission chains at any time and that each 100,000 increase in population size was associated with 9.8 additional chains. While local viral diversity was also correlated with the size of the epidemic within any month, we found diversity only had moderate predictive power to accurately recover epidemic dynamics. CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: These findings highlight the nuanced and spatially variable ecology of a highly endemic pathogen with substantial immunity. This study also illustrates the strengths of combining multiple data sources to shed light on the nature of DENV transmission.

title_zh: 泰国甘烹碧登革热 传播 的空间结构。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito transmitted arbovirus that represents a severe threat to global populations. The four serotypes of DENV often circulate endemically resulting in many discrete but overlapping transmission chains in space and time, effectively hiding the underlying patterns of transmission, and longer term consequences on local population immunity. Here we combined serotyped case data with sequence data from a single setting over 25 years to characterise the spatial dependence between cases, the number of distinct transmission chains circulating at any time and whether community transmission was followed by serotype-specific local herd immunity. METHODOLOGY/PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: In this study, we combined geolocated case data (N = 7,487) from individuals that presented at a provincial hospital in Kamphaeng Phet Province, Thailand alongside a subset of the sequences of the viruses (N = 302) that infected them. We estimated the spatial dependence between case pairs over different temporal and spatial windows, using both serotype and sequence data, and used logistic regression to identify whether host population size or epidemic size were correlated with viral diversity. We found there was spatial dependence between cases at up to 5 km, resulting in localised serotype-specific patterns of immunity in subsequent years. Within a 78.5 km2 area there were 9.6 distinct transmission chains at any time and that each 100,000 increase in population size was associated with 9.8 additional chains. While local viral diversity was also correlated with the size of the epidemic within any month, we found diversity only had moderate predictive power to accurately recover epidemic dynamics. CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: These findings highlight the nuanced and spatially variable ecology of a highly endemic pathogen with substantial immunity. This study also illustrates the strengths of combining multiple data sources to shed light on the nature of DENV transmission.

title: Epidemiological shift in age distribution of Dengue in Thailand, 2005–2024
abstract: Dengue has historically been characterized as a childhood disease, but evidence of shifting age distribution is increasing. We analyzed 20 years (2005–2024) of national dengue surveillance data from Thailand comprising 1,639,442 cases to examine temporal trends in age-specific incidence, quantify age shift magnitude using the ratio of incidence rate ratios (RIRR), and decompose observed changes using Kitagawa decomposition. The proportion of cases among adults ≥25 years nearly doubled from 19.56% to 36.16%, while the children's proportion declined from 54.49% to 41.63%. RIRR for adults 25–44 years was 1.78 (95% CI 1.76-1.80), and for older adults ≥45 years was 2.19 (95% CI 2.15-2.24). Kitagawa decomposition attributed +178.7% of change to epidemiological factors and -78.7% to demographic shifts, supporting a declining force of infection rather than population aging as the primary driver. These findings necessitate expanding dengue prevention beyond school-based programs and enhancing clinical vigilance for adult dengue.

title_zh: 2005-2024 年泰国登革热年龄分布的流行病学变化
source_body_en: Dengue has historically been characterized as a childhood disease, but evidence of shifting age distribution is increasing. We analyzed 20 years (2005–2024) of national dengue surveillance data from Thailand comprising 1,639,442 cases to examine temporal trends in age-specific incidence, quantify age shift magnitude using the ratio of incidence rate ratios (RIRR), and decompose observed changes using Kitagawa decomposition. The proportion of cases among adults ≥25 years nearly doubled from 19.56% to 36.16%, while the children's proportion declined from 54.49% to 41.63%. RIRR for adults 25–44 years was 1.78 (95% CI 1.76-1.80), and for older adults ≥45 years was 2.19 (95% CI 2.15-2.24). Kitagawa decomposition attributed +178.7% of change to epidemiological factors and -78.7% to demographic shifts, supporting a declining force of infection rather than population aging as the primary driver. These findings necessitate expanding dengue prevention beyond school-based programs and enhancing clinical vigilance for adult dengue.

title: Emerging and Re-Emerging Viral Pathogens in Oncolytic Virotherapy: A Comprehensive Review.
abstract: Oncolytic virotherapy has recently emerged as a promising immuno-oncological strategy, utilising the natural cytolytic potentials of viral pathogens to selectively target and destroy malignant cells. Although various engineered viruses, such as adenoviruses, vaccinia virus, and herpes simplex virus, are currently in clinical evaluation, emerging and re-emerging viruses with intrinsic oncolytic potential, including Zika virus (ZIKV), Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), Dengue virus (DENV), and West Nile virus (WNV), have also shown promising results. These emerging and re-emerging viral pathogens show specific tumour tropism, immune evasion strategies, and immunogenic cell death mechanisms that could be harnessed for next-generation therapeutic platforms. Nonetheless, concerns related to safety, viral pathogenicity, host immune responses, and the risk of uncontrolled viral dissemination present significant translational challenges. The present review provides a comprehensive overview of novel viral candidates, including ZIKV, SARS-CoV-2, DENV, and WNV, in oncolytic virotherapy, their molecular mechanisms of tumour targeting, and current advancements in genetic engineering aimed at improving therapeutic efficacy and biosafety. Moreover, this review describes clinical perspectives, regulatory considerations, and future directions in integrating emerging virotherapeutic agents into precision oncology.

title: Mosquito diversity and arbovirus detection in Paraguay: first evidence of dengue and chikungunya virus infection in field populations.
abstract: Arboviruses are mosquito-borne viruses of major public health importance, particularly in tropical and subtropical regions. In Paraguay, dengue (DENV) and chikungunya (CHIKV) viruses are among the most epidemiologically relevant; however, studies integrating mosquito and arbovirus surveillance remain scarce. This study aimed to characterize mosquito assemblage composition across different ecological settings and investigate arbovirus circulation in field-collected mosquitoes. A total of 4,595 mosquitoes (609 pools) were collected between 2013 and 2024 from urban, rural, and Atlantic Forest environments in Paraguay. Twenty-six mosquito species were identified, with Culex quinquefasciatus (55.3%) as the most abundant, followed by Aedes (Ochlerotatus) scapularis (13.3%). Aedes aegypti (7.3%) was mainly associated with urban areas. Diversity analyses showed higher alpha diversity and greater gamma diversity in the Atlantic Forest and lower values in rural areas, whereas high beta diversity indicated substantial species turnover among locations. Molecular screening by real-time RT-PCR detected no evidence of West Nile, Saint Louis encephalitis, Venezuelan equine encephalitis, Mayaro, yellow fever, Zika, or Oropouche viruses. aegypti pools tested positive for DENV (n=3; 2021 and 2023) and CHIKV (n=3; 2023). Phylogenetic reconstruction confirmed the circulation of DENV-4 Genotype II (lineage B.1.1), DENV-2 Genotype II (F.1.1.2), and CHIKV East/Central/South African (ECSA) lineages in Paraguay, all closely related to human outbreak-associated sequences. These findings provide the first molecular evidence of arbovirus infection in field-collected mosquitoes in Paraguay and emphasize the importance of integrated entomological and viral surveillance.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Arboviruses transmitted by mosquitoes pose significant public health threats in tropical and subtropical regions, yet Paraguay lacked integrated studies linking mosquito diversity with arbovirus circulation. The study addressed the knowledge gap by investigating arbovirus presence in field-collected mosquitoes across diverse ecological settings in Paraguay.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A total of 4,595 mosquitoes (609 pools) were collected between 2013 and 2024 from urban, rural, and Atlantic Forest environments in Paraguay. analysis.methods: Molecular screening by real-time RT-PCR was used to detect arboviruses in mosquito pools. Phylogenetic reconstruction was performed to characterize viral lineages.

analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s reliance on field-collected mosquitoes and limited temporal sampling may underrepresent viral diversity and transmission dynamics, warranting broader longitudinal surveillance to strengthen evidence.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Arboviruses transmitted by mosquitoes pose significant public health threats in tropical and subtropical regions, yet Paraguay lacked integrated studies linking mosquito diversity with arbovirus circulation. The study addressed the knowledge gap by investigating arbovirus presence in field-collected mosquitoes across diverse ecological settings in Paraguay.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A total of 4,595 mosquitoes (609 pools) were collected between 2013 and 2024 from urban, rural, and Atlantic Forest environments in Paraguay. Twenty-six mosquito species were identified, with Culex quinquefasciatus as the most abundant, followed by Aedes (Ochlerotatus) scapularis and Aedes aegypti.
analysis_en.methods: Molecular screening by real-time RT-PCR was used to detect arboviruses in mosquito pools. Phylogenetic reconstruction was performed to characterize viral lineages.
analysis_en.main_results: Dengue virus (DENV) was detected in three Aedes aegypti pools (2021 and 2023), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV) in three pools (2023). Phylogenetic analysis identified DENV-4 Genotype II (lineage B.1.1), DENV-2 Genotype II (F.1.1.2), and CHIKV East/Central/South African (ECSA) lineages, all closely related to human outbreak-associated sequences.

analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings support targeted vector control and surveillance strategies in Paraguay, particularly in urban areas where Aedes aegypti predominates, to mitigate dengue and chikungunya transmission risks.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s reliance on field-collected mosquitoes and limited temporal sampling may underrepresent viral diversity and transmission dynamics, warranting broader longitudinal surveillance to strengthen evidence.

title_zh: 巴拉圭的蚊子多样性和虫媒病毒检测:野外人群中登革热和基孔肯雅病毒感染的第一个证据。
source_body_en: Arboviruses are mosquito-borne viruses of major public health importance, particularly in tropical and subtropical regions. In Paraguay, dengue (DENV) and chikungunya (CHIKV) viruses are among the most epidemiologically relevant; however, studies integrating mosquito and arbovirus surveillance remain scarce. This study aimed to characterize mosquito assemblage composition across different ecological settings and investigate arbovirus circulation in field-collected mosquitoes. A total of 4,595 mosquitoes (609 pools) were collected between 2013 and 2024 from urban, rural, and Atlantic Forest environments in Paraguay. Twenty-six mosquito species were identified, with Culex quinquefasciatus (55.3%) as the most abundant, followed by Aedes (Ochlerotatus) scapularis (13.3%). Aedes aegypti (7.3%) was mainly associated with urban areas. Diversity analyses showed higher alpha diversity and greater gamma diversity in the Atlantic Forest and lower values in rural areas, whereas high beta diversity indicated substantial species turnover among locations. Molecular screening by real-time RT-PCR detected no evidence of West Nile, Saint Louis encephalitis, Venezuelan equine encephalitis, Mayaro, yellow fever, Zika, or Oropouche viruses. aegypti pools tested positive for DENV (n=3; 2021 and 2023) and CHIKV (n=3; 2023). Phylogenetic reconstruction confirmed the circulation of DENV-4 Genotype II (lineage B.1.1), DENV-2 Genotype II (F.1.1.2), and CHIKV East/Central/South African (ECSA) lineages in Paraguay, all closely related to human outbreak-associated sequences. These findings provide the first molecular evidence of arbovirus infection in field-collected mosquitoes in Paraguay and emphasize the importance of integrated entomological and viral surveillance.

title: Invasive Aspergillosis Following Dengue: An Autopsy Case and Review of the Literature.
abstract: Invasive aspergillosis typically occurs in immunocompromised hosts but has been increasingly recognized following viral illnesses, including dengue and coronavirus disease 2019. Herein, a fatal case of disseminated aspergillosis following severe dengue is described, and the association is systematically reviewed. A previously healthy 25-year-old woman presented with fever and multiorgan dysfunction. Dengue IgM results were positive, and other tropical infections were excluded. Despite intensive care, the patient developed progressive respiratory failure, refractory shock, and acute kidney injury and died. An autopsy revealed diffuse alveolar damage and extensive invasive aspergillosis involving the bronchi, pulmonary vasculature, and myocardium. In the present systematic review, 21 additional cases of invasive aspergillosis following dengue (total n = 22; median age 36 years, 59% male) were identified, predominantly in Asia. Fifteen cases (68%) had pulmonary involvement. Most patients had severe dengue with multiorgan dysfunction. The overall mortality was 63.6%; 23% of cases were diagnosed postmortem. Invasive aspergillosis complicating severe dengue broadens the spectrum of viral-associated aspergillosis.
journal: The American journal of tropical medicine and hygiene

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 侵袭性曲霉病通常发生在免疫功能低下的 宿主 中,但在病毒性疾病(包括登革热和 2019 年冠状病毒病)之后,人们越来越多地认识到侵袭性曲霉病。本文描述了 重症登革热 后传播性曲霉病的致命病例,并对这种关联进行了系统评价。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 在本次系统评价中,发现了另外 21 例登革热后侵袭性曲霉病病例(总数 = 22;中位年龄 36 岁,59% 男性),主要发生在亚洲。登革热 IgM 结果呈阳性,排除其他热带感染。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 一名先前健康的 25 岁女性出现发烧和多器官功能障碍。总体死亡率为63.6%;23%的病例是尸检确诊的。侵袭性曲霉病并发 重症登革热 拓宽了病毒相关曲霉病的范围。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 大多数患者患有 重症登革热 并伴有多器官功能障碍。15 例(68%)有肺部受累。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 尸检显示弥漫性肺泡损伤和广泛的侵袭性曲霉菌病,累及支气管、肺血管系统和心肌。尽管接受了重症监护,患者还是出现了进行性呼吸衰竭、难治性休克和急性肾损伤,最终死亡。

title_zh: 登革热后的侵袭性曲霉病:尸检病例和文献综述。
source_body_en: Invasive aspergillosis typically occurs in immunocompromised hosts but has been increasingly recognized following viral illnesses, including dengue and coronavirus disease 2019. Herein, a fatal case of disseminated aspergillosis following severe dengue is described, and the association is systematically reviewed. A previously healthy 25-year-old woman presented with fever and multiorgan dysfunction. Dengue IgM results were positive, and other tropical infections were excluded. Despite intensive care, the patient developed progressive respiratory failure, refractory shock, and acute kidney injury and died. An autopsy revealed diffuse alveolar damage and extensive invasive aspergillosis involving the bronchi, pulmonary vasculature, and myocardium. In the present systematic review, 21 additional cases of invasive aspergillosis following dengue (total n = 22; median age 36 years, 59% male) were identified, predominantly in Asia. Fifteen cases (68%) had pulmonary involvement. Most patients had severe dengue with multiorgan dysfunction. The overall mortality was 63.6%; 23% of cases were diagnosed postmortem. Invasive aspergillosis complicating severe dengue broadens the spectrum of viral-associated aspergillosis.

title: Community participation and operational lessons from implementing a protective coating as a novel vector control tool in dengue-endemic neighborhoods of Cúcuta and Los Patios, Colombia.
abstract: Abstract Background The control of Aedes-borne diseases (dengue, Zika, chikungunya, yellow fever) is a high public health priority in tropical and subtropical countries. The adoption of new vector control tools, such as protective coating (PC), requires understanding the social dynamics that influence their acceptance and feasibility. This study investigated the experiences and perspectives of diverse stakeholders involved in a vector control project in urban Colombia, with the aim of assessing community acceptance and operational feasibility. Insights gained are important for optimizing implementation and gauging the broader viability of innovative vector control strategies. Methods A qualitative descriptive study was conducted using focus group discussions and in-depth interviews with 70 key stakeholders, including community leaders ( n = 3), community volunteers ( n = 30), vector control staff ( n = 7), supervisors ( n = 5), and community residents ( n = 25). Data was collected after the intervention and analyzed using inductive thematic content analysis with open coding. Participation was voluntary and confidential. Results The protective coating was perceived as feasible and generally well accepted by the community. Facilitating factors included the involvement of community leaders, strong volunteer commitment, and effective coordination among institutions. Challenges such as trust issues, logistical constraints, and safety concerns were identified and addressed through adaptive strategies, including adjusted work schedules and strengthened communication. Conclusion Community involvement, effective communication, and adaptive management were key to the successful implementation of the protective coating and helped address logistical challenges. The lessons learned provide useful information for scaling up novel vector control approaches in similar urban settings in Latin America.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 控制伊蚊传播的疾病(登革热、寨卡、基孔肯雅热、黄热病)是热带和亚热带国家公共卫生的高度优先事项。采用新的 媒介 控制工具(例如保护涂层 (PC))需要了解影响其接受度和可行性的社会动态。本研究调查了参与哥伦比亚城市 媒介 控制项目的不同利益相关者的经验和观点,旨在评估社区接受度和运营可行性。获得的见解对于优化实施和衡量创新 媒介 控制策略的更广泛可行性非常重要。方法采用焦点小组讨论和深度访谈的方式,对社区领导(n=3)、社区志愿者(n=30)、媒介控制人员(n=7)、督导员(n=5)和社区居民(n=25)等70名关键利益相关者进行定性描述性研究。干预后收集数据,并使用开放编码的归纳主题内容分析进行分析。参与是自愿且保密的。结果保护涂层被认为是可行的并且普遍被社区所接受。促进因素包括社区领袖的参与、志愿者的坚定承诺以及机构之间的有效协调。通过适应性策略(包括调整工作时间表和加强沟通)识别并解决了信任问题、后勤限制和安全问题等挑战。结论 社区参与、有效沟通和适应性管理是成功实施保护涂层的关键,并有助于解决后勤挑战。吸取的经验教训为在拉丁美洲类似城市环境中推广新颖的 媒介 控制方法提供了有用的信息。

title: Dengue Vector Dynamics in India: Present and Future Multi-Model Suitability under SSP Scenarios Using a Machine Learning-Based Maximum Entropy Model
abstract: Abstract Dengue Fever has emerged as an alarming climate-sensitive disease in India in recent time. This study examines the present and future climatic suitability of dengue transmission using a species distribution modelling (MaxEnt). High-resolution bioclimatic data of CHELSA v2.1 dataset (~ 1 km resolution) and georeferenced occurrence data of Aedes aegypti from various sources are used. Overall, the study highlights that dengue risk in India is not only a future concern but an ongoing challenge.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 近年来,登革热 在印度已成为一种令人担忧的气候敏感疾病。该研究旨在评估当前和未来不同社会经济情景下登革热 传播 的多模型适用性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用物种分布建模 (MaxEnt) 方法检查登革热 传播 当前和未来的气候适宜性。使用 CHELSA v2.1 数据集的高分辨率生物气候数据(约 1 公里分辨率)和来自不同来源的埃及伊蚊的地理参考发生数据。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用基于机器学习的最大熵模型,根据五个大气循环模型(GFDL-ESM4、IPSL-CM6A-LR、MPI-ESM1-2-HR、MRI-ESM2-0、UKESM1-0-LL)和三个共享社会经济路径(SSP126、SSP370、SSP585)生成近(2011-2040)中期的未来预测。(2041-2070)和遥远的未来(2071-2100)时期。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果显示,印度一半以上的地区气候适合登革热传播。西高止山脉、东部沿海地区和东北部各州的适宜性较高。未来的预测表明,变化是通过空间重新分配而不是统一扩张来实现的,包括逐渐北移和高排放情景下适宜性的局部降低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该模型显示出中等的预测性能(AUC = 0.79,TSS = 0.53),而高博伊斯指数(0.9)表明在识别合适的栖息地方面具有很强的生态一致性。与报告的登革热 发病率 的比较进一步表明,即使在被归类为中等适宜性的地区,也存在大量的 传播,这表明仅较高的适宜性并不能完全决定疾病负担。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,印度的登革热风险不仅是未来的担忧,也是持续的挑战。该研究提供了对登革热 监测 空间动态的见解,可以为有针对性的 监测 和干预策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅基于抽象证据,该模型的中等预测性能(AUC = 0.79,TSS = 0.53)表明其准确性存在一些局限性。结果基于气候数据和发生记录,可能无法完全捕获影响登革热 传播 的所有因素。

title: Molecular Characterization of DENV-1 Isolates From Pakistan Reveals Immunogenic Variability and Antiviral Potential of Phytochemicals Targeting the CprM Region.
abstract: Dengue virus (DENV), a mosquito-borne arbovirus, remains a critical global health concern, causing approximately 390 million infections annually. Dengue fever poses significant challenges to healthcare systems in endemic regions like Pakistan due to the presence of four established serotypes (DENV-1-DENV-4) and the potential emergence of a fifth serotype (DENV-5). The current study aimed to investigate molecular characteristics of DENV-1 isolates from Peshawar, Pakistan, focusing on serotyping, genetic variability in the CprM junction region, and identification of potential antiviral phytochemicals. A total of 45 patient samples were screened, with the highest infection rate (49%) observed among individuals aged 20-40 years. Phylogenetic analysis revealed that six isolates clustered within the DENV-1 clade and grouped closely related to isolates from China, India, Bangladesh, and Pakistan, suggesting a regional evolution and potentially cross-border transmission. The prominent amino acid substitutions were Q47H, G48E, P49H, K51 E/N, L52 M, and M57I, which may influence viral structure, immune evasion, and antigenic properties. To address the lack of effective antivirals, a library of 60 phytochemicals was screened. Nine compounds demonstrated favorable ADMET profiles and high binding affinity (docking scores < -100) with the CprM region. Silydianin exhibited the strongest interaction (-159.81), indicating promising inhibitory potential. This integrative molecular and computational approach enhances our understanding of circulating DENV-1 strains and highlights plant-derived compounds as candidates for future antiviral development, pending in vitro validation.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue virus (DENV) causes substantial global morbidity, yet effective antivirals remain lacking, particularly in endemic regions such as Pakistan where multiple serotypes co-circulate. The study addressed the knowledge gap regarding molecular characteristics of circulating DENV-1 isolates and their potential impact on immunity and antiviral development.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study screened 45 patient samples from Peshawar, Pakistan, with the highest infection rate (49%) observed among individuals aged 20–40 years. It focused on DENV-1 isolates, examining serotyping, genetic variability in the CprM junction region, and antiviral potential of phytochemicals.
analysis.methods: Phylogenetic analysis was performed to assess genetic variability and regional evolution of DENV-1 isolates. A library of 60 phytochemicals was screened for antiviral potential, with binding affinity to the CprM region evaluated using docking scores and ADMET profiling.
analysis.main_results: Phylogenetic analysis identified six DENV-1 isolates clustering closely with regional strains from China, India, Bangladesh, and Pakistan. Six amino acid substitutions (Q47H, G48E, P49H, K51E/N, L52M, M57I) were detected in the CprM region. Nine phytochemicals showed high binding affinity (docking scores < -100) to the CprM region, with silydianin exhibiting the strongest interaction (-159.81).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The observed amino acid substitutions in the CprM region may influence viral structure, immune evasion, and antigenic properties, highlighting potential targets for antiviral design. The identification of silydianin as a high-affinity binder to the CprM region represents a novel computational lead for DENV-1 antiviral development.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings inform surveillance strategies by characterizing circulating DENV-1 variants in Pakistan and support the exploration of plant-derived compounds as candidates for antiviral therapy, pending in vitro validation.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on computational docking and in silico ADMET profiling without in vitro or in vivo validation, which constrains the strength of evidence for antiviral efficacy. The small sample size (n=45) and focus on a single region may limit generalizability of phylogenetic and substitution findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study characterized DENV-1 isolates from Peshawar, Pakistan, identifying six isolates phylogenetically linked to regional strains and six amino acid substitutions in the CprM region that may affect viral structure and antigenicity. Computational screening of 60 phytochemicals revealed nine compounds with high binding affinity to the CprM region, including silydianin, which showed the strongest interaction. The findings highlight potential targets for antiviral design and support further exploration of plant-derived compounds, though validation through in vitro and in vivo studies is required. The study’s small sample size and reliance on computational methods limit the strength of evidence and generalizability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒 (DENV) 在全球造成大量发病,但有效的 抗病毒药物 仍然缺乏,特别是在多种血清型共同传播的巴基斯坦等流行地区。该研究解决了有关循环 DENV-1 分离株的分子特征及其对免疫和 抗病毒药物 发育的潜在影响的知识差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究筛查了来自巴基斯坦白沙瓦的 45 名患者样本,在 20-40 岁的个体中观察到感染率最高(49%)。它重点关注 DENV-1 分离株,检查血清分型、CprM 连接区域的遗传变异性以及植物化学物质的 抗病毒药物 潜力。
elements_zh.methods: 进行系统发育分析以评估 DENV-1 分离株的遗传变异性和区域 进化。针对 抗病毒药物 潜力筛选了 60 种植物化学物质的库,并使用对接分数和 ADMET 分析评估了与 CprM 区域的结合亲和力。
elements_zh.main_results: 系统发育分析发现了 6 个 DENV-1 分离株与来自中国、印度、孟加拉国和巴基斯坦的区域毒株紧密聚集。在 CprM 区域检测到 6 个氨基酸取代(Q47H、G48E、P49H、K51E/N、L52M、M57I)。九种植物化学物质对 CprM 区域表现出高结合亲和力(对接分数 < -100),其中水飞蓟宁表现出最强的相互作用(-159.81)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在 CprM 区域观察到的氨基酸取代可能会影响病毒结构、免疫逃避和抗原特性,突出了 抗病毒药物 设计的潜在目标。水飞蓟宁作为 CprM 区域高亲和力结合剂的鉴定代表了 DENV-1 抗病毒药物 开发的新计算线索。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现通过表征巴基斯坦循环的 DENV-1 变体为 监测 策略提供信息,并支持探索植物源化合物作为 抗病毒药物 疗法的候选药物,有待体外验证。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖于计算对接和计算机 ADMET 分析,而没有体外或体内验证,这限制了 抗病毒药物 功效的证据强度。小样本量(n = 45)和关注单一区域可能会限制系统发育和替代研究结果的普遍性。

analysis_zh.main_results: 系统发育分析发现了 6 个 DENV-1 分离株与来自中国、印度、孟加拉国和巴基斯坦的区域毒株紧密聚集。在 CprM 区域检测到 6 个氨基酸取代(Q47H、G48E、P49H、K51E/N、L52M、M57I)。九种植物化学物质对 CprM 区域表现出高结合亲和力(对接分数 < -100),其中水飞蓟宁表现出最强的相互作用(-159.81)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在 CprM 区域观察到的氨基酸取代可能会影响病毒结构、免疫逃避和抗原特性,突出了 抗病毒药物 设计的潜在目标。水飞蓟宁作为 CprM 区域高亲和力结合剂的鉴定代表了 DENV-1 抗病毒药物 开发的新计算线索。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现通过表征巴基斯坦循环的 DENV-1 变体为 监测 策略提供信息,并支持探索植物源化合物作为 抗病毒药物 疗法的候选药物,有待体外验证。

title: Molecular Detection of the -308 G/A Polymorphism in the Tumor Necrosis Factor Alpha (TNFα) Gene Promoter and Its Relationship with the Development of Severe Dengue in Patients from Urabá Subregion, Antioquia-Colombia
abstract: Background: dengue fever is a viral infection caused by the Dengue Virus (DENV), a positive-sense RNA virus belonging to Flaviviridae family. The virus is transmitted to humans through the bite of the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Worldwide, between 100 and 400 million cases are reported annually. The infection in humans can cause three clinical forms which are related to severity: dengue without warnings signs, dengue with warnings signs, and severe dengue. Mutations in some genes that code for immune system proteins have been linked to the appearance of severe clinical forms of the disease, including TNF-α. The TNF-α plays a key role in the immunopathogenesis of the disease: mutations in this gene can increase the production of TNF-α, favoring cytokine storms and vascular damage, which is associated with severe clinical forms of the disease. Therefore, it is important to study the immunopathogenesis of the disease in the human to try to predict and control the onset of severe clinical forms and fatal cases. Methods: This study explores the link between TNF-α promoter gene polymorphism and dengue severity. We re-cruited 92 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases, including 30 dengue without warnings signs, 43 dengue with warnings signs, and 19 severe dengue. Genotyping was done using amplification by PCR (polymerase chain reaction), Sanger sequencing, and bio-informatics analysis of the TNF-α gene promoter mutations. A logistic regression assessed the association between -308 G/A TNF-α mutation and dengue severity. Results: the mutated genotype -308 G/A TNF-α was detected in 10.5% of severe cases. Interestingly, Severe cases showed higher odds of carrying the mutation than those without warnings signs. Severe cases were twice as likely to possess this mutation compared to those with warnings signs, however, no statistically significant differences were found. Genotype frequencies were consistent with Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium (p = 0.112). The estimated post hoc statistical power was 11.3%. Conclusions: Although no statistically significant association was detected, the TNF-α -308G/A polymorphism showed a trend toward increased susceptibility to severe dengue, with a higher frequency among severe cases than among patients with or without warnings signs.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the relationship between the TNF-α -308 G/A polymorphism and the severity of dengue infection in the Urabá subregion of Antioquia, Colombia. However, no statistically significant differences were found. The findings may inform future research on the immunopathogenesis of dengue and its clinical implications.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热 是由 登革病毒 (DENV) 引起的病毒感染,登革病毒 是黄病毒科的正链 RNA 病毒。人类感染可引起三种与严重程度相关的临床形式:无警告信号的登革热、有警告信号的登革热和 重症登革热。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究探讨了 TNF-α 启动子基因多态性与登革热严重程度之间的联系。我们重新招募了 92 例实验室确诊的登革热病例,其中 30 例没有警告标志的登革热病例、43 例有警告标志的登革热病例和 19 例 重症登革热。
elements_zh.methods: 通过 PCR(聚合酶链式反应)扩增、Sanger 测序和 TNF-α 基因启动子 突变 的生物信息学分析完成基因分型。逻辑回归评估了 -308 G/A TNF-α 突变 与登革热严重程度之间的关联。

title_zh: 哥伦比亚安蒂奥基亚省乌拉巴分区患者肿瘤坏死因子α (TNFα) 基因启动子-308 G/A 多态性的分子检测及其与 重症登革热 发展的关系
source_body_en: Background: dengue fever is a viral infection caused by the Dengue Virus (DENV), a positive-sense RNA virus belonging to Flaviviridae family. The virus is transmitted to humans through the bite of the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Worldwide, between 100 and 400 million cases are reported annually. The infection in humans can cause three clinical forms which are related to severity: dengue without warnings signs, dengue with warnings signs, and severe dengue. Mutations in some genes that code for immune system proteins have been linked to the appearance of severe clinical forms of the disease, including TNF-α. The TNF-α plays a key role in the immunopathogenesis of the disease: mutations in this gene can increase the production of TNF-α, favoring cytokine storms and vascular damage, which is associated with severe clinical forms of the disease. Therefore, it is important to study the immunopathogenesis of the disease in the human to try to predict and control the onset of severe clinical forms and fatal cases. Methods: This study explores the link between TNF-α promoter gene polymorphism and dengue severity. We re-cruited 92 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases, including 30 dengue without warnings signs, 43 dengue with warnings signs, and 19 severe dengue. Genotyping was done using amplification by PCR (polymerase chain reaction), Sanger sequencing, and bio-informatics analysis of the TNF-α gene promoter mutations. A logistic regression assessed the association between -308 G/A TNF-α mutation and dengue severity. Results: the mutated genotype -308 G/A TNF-α was detected in 10.5% of severe cases. Interestingly, Severe cases showed higher odds of carrying the mutation than those without warnings signs. Severe cases were twice as likely to possess this mutation compared to those with warnings signs, however, no statistically significant differences were found. Genotype frequencies were consistent with Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium (p = 0.112). The estimated post hoc statistical power was 11.3%. Conclusions: Although no statistically significant association was detected, the TNF-α -308G/A polymorphism showed a trend toward increased susceptibility to severe dengue, with a higher frequency among severe cases than among patients with or without warnings signs.

title: Dengue virus rNS3pro immunization is associated with the expansion of regulatory-like T-cell phenotypes in BALB/c mice.
abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) nonstructural protein 3 (NS3) is essential for viral replication and host immune evasion. While its protease domain (NS3pro) has been linked to T-cell anergy, its role in inducing regulatory T cells (Tregs) requires further exploration. To analyze the induction of diverse regulatory T-cell populations in BALB/c mice immunized with recombinant rNS3pro proteins from the four DENV serotypes. Mice were immunized with rNS3pro, and splenocytes were stimulated in vitro with homologous proteins. Cytokine expression and T-cell phenotypes-including markers for activation, exhaustion, and cytotoxicity-were analyzed via RT-PCR, ELISA, and flow cytometry. rNS3pro immunization induced a predominantly regulatory-associated response characterized by significant IL-10 expression. A marked expansion of CD4+CD25+ T cells (23.5% vs. 1.05% in controls) was observed, encompassing CD25+FoxP3+ regulatory-like T cells, alongside FoxP3-independent subsets expressing CD25+IL-10+ and CD25+TGF-β+. These cells co-expressed cytotoxicity-associated (FoxP3+Perforin+/GzB+) and co-inhibitory (CTLA-4+, PD-1+) markers. Effector CD8+ T-cell proliferation was significantly inhibited and could not be restored by exogenous IL-2. In conclusion, DENV rNS3pro immunization drives a robust expansion of multifaceted regulatory-like T-cell phenotypes. This immunomodulatory response correlates with compromised CD8+ effector proliferation, identifying the NS3 protease domain as a potential player in DENV immune evasion strategies.

title_zh: 登革病毒 rNS3pro 免疫与 BALB/c 小鼠中调节性 T 细胞表型的扩展相关。
source_body_en: Dengue virus (DENV) nonstructural protein 3 (NS3) is essential for viral replication and host immune evasion. While its protease domain (NS3pro) has been linked to T-cell anergy, its role in inducing regulatory T cells (Tregs) requires further exploration. To analyze the induction of diverse regulatory T-cell populations in BALB/c mice immunized with recombinant rNS3pro proteins from the four DENV serotypes. Mice were immunized with rNS3pro, and splenocytes were stimulated in vitro with homologous proteins. Cytokine expression and T-cell phenotypes-including markers for activation, exhaustion, and cytotoxicity-were analyzed via RT-PCR, ELISA, and flow cytometry. rNS3pro immunization induced a predominantly regulatory-associated response characterized by significant IL-10 expression. A marked expansion of CD4+CD25+ T cells (23.5% vs. 1.05% in controls) was observed, encompassing CD25+FoxP3+ regulatory-like T cells, alongside FoxP3-independent subsets expressing CD25+IL-10+ and CD25+TGF-β+. These cells co-expressed cytotoxicity-associated (FoxP3+Perforin+/GzB+) and co-inhibitory (CTLA-4+, PD-1+) markers. Effector CD8+ T-cell proliferation was significantly inhibited and could not be restored by exogenous IL-2. In conclusion, DENV rNS3pro immunization drives a robust expansion of multifaceted regulatory-like T-cell phenotypes. This immunomodulatory response correlates with compromised CD8+ effector proliferation, identifying the NS3 protease domain as a potential player in DENV immune evasion strategies.

title: Prevalence of neutralizing autoantibodies against type I interferon in dengue patients.
abstract: The presence of neutralizing autoantibodies (NAbs) against type I IFN (IFN-I) has been associated with severe complications arising from various viral infections. However, the prevalence of IFN-I NAbs in dengue virus (DENV) infection remains unclear. Here, we enrolled 216 hospitalized dengue patients in 2024, including 7 individuals with dengue shock syndrome (DSS) and 42 individuals with dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF). Utilizing a sensitive luciferase reporter assay, IFN-I NAbs were detected in 7 patients (14.3% of DSS/DHF cases), and their neutralizing ability was further validated in DENV-infected cells. Notably, all NAb-positive patients exhibited plasma leakage tendency and cardiac injury and were significantly older than the overall cohort (75.34 vs. IFN-I NAbs were correlated with clinical parameters of myocardial injury and plasma leakage, with increased odds ratio (OR) for cardiac injury (OR = 22.8, P = 0.003) and hypoproteinemia (OR = 53.5, P = 0.001). These findings suggest that IFN-I NAbs may contribute to severe clinical manifestations of dengue, warranting validation in larger cohorts.

title: Dinamika Epidemiologi Demam Berdarah Dengue dalam Perspektif Kesehatan Masyarakat: Tren Satu Dekade dan Variabilitas Iklim di Nusa Tenggara Barat
abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue hemorrhagic fever remains a pressing public health concern in tropical regions, although the influence of climatic factors varies across local settings. This study aims to describe the epidemiological patterns of dengue over a ten-year period in West Nusa Tenggara (NTB), Indonesia, and to examine its association with climate variability. Secondary annual data from 2015 to 2024 were analyzed, including dengue incidence, mortality, and case fatality rate (CFR), along with meteorological indicators such as average and maximum temperature, relative humidity, rainfall, number of rainy days, and duration of sunshine. Descriptive statistics were performed, followed by simple linear regression to explore potential relationships. Time series modeling was applied to assess predictive capacity. Dengue incidence ranged from 10.7 to 88.9 per 100,000 population (mean 51.7/100,000), with CFR consistently below 2%. Annual variations coincided with major disruptive events, including the 2018 earthquake and the COVID-19 pandemic. Linear regression analysis demonstrated consistent patterns: relative humidity showed a positive association with incidence (B ≈ +9.8, R2 up to 0.45, p = 0.071 when pandemic years were excluded), whereas average temperature and sunshine duration exhibited inverse relationships. Rainfall and number of rainy days showed weak and inconsistent associations. Time series analysis using Holt’s exponential smoothing captured short-term variability (stationary R2 = 0.82) but produced relatively high prediction error (MAPE 44%). In NTB, dengue incidence fluctuates annually and is influenced by climatic variability as well as extraordinary events such as earthquakes and the COVID-19 pandemic. Relative humidity appears to be the most consistent climatic determinant. Time series modeling reflects short-term trends but lacks precision, underscoring the importance of strengthening local surveillance systems. Keywords: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever, Climate Variability, Epidemiology, Humidity, West Nusa Tenggara. ABSTRAK Demam berdarah dengue masih menjadi masalah kesehatan masyarakat yang mendesak di wilayah tropis, namun pengaruh iklim bervariasi antar konteks lokal. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menggambarkan epidemiologi demam berdarah dengue selama satu dekade di Nusa Tenggara Barat (NTB), Indonesia, dan mengkaji hubungannya dengan variabilitas iklim. Data tahunan sekunder dari tahun 2015–2024 dianalisis, meliputi insiden demam berdarah, mortalitas, dan tingkat fatalitas kasus (CFR) beserta indikator meteorologi (suhu rata-rata dan maksimum, kelembapan relatif, curah hujan, hari hujan, dan durasi sinar matahari). Statistik deskriptif dilakukan, dilanjutkan dengan regresi linier sederhana untuk mengeksplorasi hubungan. Pemodelan deret waktu diterapkan untuk menilai potensi prediktif. Insiden dengue berkisar antara 10,7 dan 88,9 per 100.000 penduduk (rata-rata 51,7/100.000), dengan CFR secara konsisten di bawah 2%. Fluktuasi tahunan bertepatan dengan peristiwa anomali seperti gempa bumi tahun 2018 dan pandemi COVID-19. Regresi linier menunjukkan tren yang konsisten: kelembapan relatif berkorelasi positif dengan insiden (B ≈ +9,8, R2 hingga 0,45, p = 0,071 ketika tahun pandemi tidak termasuk), sementara suhu rata-rata dan durasi sinar matahari berkorelasi terbalik. Curah hujan dan hari hujan memberikan kontribusi asosiasi yang lemah dan tidak konsisten. Analisis deret waktu (pemulusan eksponensial Holt) menangkap variabilitas jangka pendek (R2 stasioner = 0,82) tetapi menunjukkan kesalahan prediksi yang tinggi (MAPE 44%). Di NTB, insiden demam berdarah berfluktuasi setiap tahun, dipengaruhi oleh variasi iklim serta kejadian luar biasa seperti gempa bumi dan wabah COVID-19. Kelembapan menunjukkan hubungan paling konsisten dengan insiden. Pemodelan deret waktu mencerminkan pola jangka pendek tetapi kurang presisi, sehingga menyoroti pentingnya sistem pengawasan lokal. Kata Kunci: Demam Berdarah, Perubahan Iklim, Epidemiologi, Kelembaban, Nusa Barat Tenggara.

ABSTRAK Demam berdarah dengue masih menjadi masalah kesehatan masyarakat yang mendesak di wilayah tropis, namun pengaruh iklim bervariasi antar konteks lokal. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menggambarkan epidemiologi demam berdarah dengue selama satu dekade di Nusa Tenggara Barat (NTB), Indonesia, dan mengkaji hubungannya dengan variabilitas iklim. Data tahunan sekunder dari tahun 2015–2024 dianalisis, meliputi insiden demam berdarah, mortalitas, dan tingkat fatalitas kasus (CFR) beserta indikator meteorologi (suhu rata-rata dan maksimum, kelembapan relatif, curah hujan, hari hujan, dan durasi sinar matahari). Statistik deskriptif dilakukan, dilanjutkan dengan regresi linier sederhana untuk mengeksplorasi hubungan. Pemodelan deret waktu diterapkan untuk menilai potensi prediktif. Insiden dengue berkisar antara 10,7 dan 88,9 per 100.000 penduduk (rata-rata 51,7/100.000), dengan CFR secara konsisten di bawah 2%. Fluktuasi tahunan bertepatan dengan peristiwa anomali seperti gempa bumi tahun 2018 dan pandemi COVID-19. Regresi linier menunjukkan tren yang konsisten: kelembapan relatif berkorelasi positif dengan insiden (B ≈ +9,8, R2 hingga 0,45, p = 0,071 ketika tahun pandemi tidak termasuk), sementara suhu rata-rata dan durasi sinar matahari berkorelasi terbalik. Curah hujan dan hari hujan memberikan kontribusi asosiasi yang lemah dan tidak konsisten. Analisis deret waktu (pemulusan eksponensial Holt) menangkap variabilitas jangka pendek (R2 stasioner = 0,82) tetapi menunjukkan kesalahan prediksi yang tinggi (MAPE 44%). Di NTB, insiden demam berdarah berfluktuasi setiap tahun, dipengaruhi oleh variasi iklim serta kejadian luar biasa seperti gempa bumi dan wabah COVID-19. Kelembapan menunjukkan hubungan paling konsisten dengan insiden. Pemodelan deret waktu mencerminkan pola jangka pendek tetapi kurang presisi, sehingga menyoroti pentingnya sistem pengawasan lokal. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述印度尼西亚西努沙登加拉省 (NTB) 十年间登革热的流行病学模式,并探讨其与气候变化的关系。尽管气候因素的影响因当地环境而异,但登革出血热仍然是热带地区紧迫的公共卫生问题。

elements_zh.methods: 进行描述性统计,然后进行简单线性回归以探索潜在关系。应用时间序列模型来评估预测能力。
elements_zh.main_results: 登革热 发病率 范围为每 100,000 人 10.7 至 88.9 人(平均 51.7/100,000),病死率始终低于 2%。线性回归分析显示了一致的模式:相对湿度与 发病率 呈正相关(B ≈ +9.8,R2 高达 0.45,当排除大流行年份时,p = 0.071),而平均温度和日照时长则呈现负相关。降雨量和下雨天数显示出微弱且不一致的关联。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 相对湿度似乎是最一致的气候决定因素。时间序列建模反映了短期趋势,但缺乏精度,凸显了加强本地 监测 系统的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 在 NTB,登革热 发病率 每年都会波动,并受到气候变化以及地震和 COVID-19 大流行等异常事件的影响。研究结果强调需要改进本地 监测 系统,以更好地监测和预测登革热 监测。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 使用 Holt 指数平滑的时间序列分析捕获了短期变异性(平稳 R2 = 0.82),但产生了相对较高的预测误差(MAPE 44%)。提供的证据未报告具体的统计功效或样本量计算。

title: Association of Pre-Existing Antithrombotic Therapy With Clinical Outcomes in Patients with Acute Dengue Infection.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue infection frequently causes thrombocytopenia and bleeding complications. Patients with cardiovascular disease who receive antiplatelet or anticoagulant therapy represent a clinically challenging population during acute dengue infection. Data regarding clinical outcomes and platelet recovery in these patients remain limited. METHODS: This observational study included a single-center retrospective cardiovascular dengue cohort and an exploratory platelet-monitoring cohort. In the retrospective cohort, patients were classified according to pre-existing antithrombotic therapy (ATT) at dengue diagnosis: no antithrombotic therapy (No ATT), single antiplatelet therapy (SAPT), dual antiplatelet therapy (DAPT), or oral anticoagulant therapy (OAC). Major bleeding was assessed within 7 and 30 days after dengue diagnosis. In the exploratory platelet-monitoring cohort, serial platelet count and platelet function were assessed during dengue illness. RESULTS: The retrospective cohort included 1,693 patients (No ATT, n = 1,493; SAPT, n = 163; DAPT, n = 22; OAC, n = 15). ATT users were older and had a greater burden of cardiovascular comorbidities and more frequent severe dengue manifestations. The observed 7-day major bleeding rates in the No ATT, SAPT, DAPT, and OAC groups were 0.34%, 0.61%, 4.55%, and 6.67%, respectively (P = 0.011), with corresponding 30-day rates of 1.15%, 1.84%, 9.09%, and 13.33% (P = 0.002). analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the association between pre-existing antithrombotic therapy and clinical outcomes in patients with acute dengue infection. It reports that patients on antithrombotic therapy had a greater comorbidity burden and more severe dengue manifestations. The observed major bleeding rates were higher in those on dual antiplatelet therapy and oral anticoagulant therapy compared to those without antithrombotic therapy. The study suggests that aspirin users may experience delayed platelet count and function recovery. The findings may inform clinical management and future research on the impact of antithrombotic therapy on dengue outcomes. However, the study's observational design and potential confounding factors limit the strength of the evidence, which is assessed as moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热感染经常引起血小板减少和出血并发症。有关这些患者的临床结果和血小板恢复的数据仍然有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 接受抗血小板或抗凝治疗的心血管疾病患者是急性登革热感染期间临床上具有挑战性的人群。这项观察性研究包括单中心回顾性心血管登革热 队列研究 和探索性血小板监测 队列研究。
elements_zh.methods: 在回顾性 队列研究 中,根据登革热 诊断 时已有的抗血栓治疗 (ATT) 对患者进行分类:无抗血栓治疗 (No ATT)、单一抗血小板治疗 (SAPT)、双重抗血小板治疗 (DAPT) 或口服抗凝治疗 (OAC)。在登革热 诊断 后 7 和 30 天内评估大出血情况。在探索性血小板监测 队列研究 中,对登革热疾病期间的连续血小板计数和血小板功能进行了评估。
elements_zh.main_results: 回顾性 队列研究 包括 1,693 名患者(无 ATT,n = 1,493;SAPT,n = 163;DAPT,n = 22;OAC,n = 15)。ATT 用户年龄较大,心血管合并症负担更大,且 重症登革热 表现更频繁。No ATT、SAPT、DAPT 和 OAC 组观察到的 7 天大出血率分别为 0.34%、0.61%、4.55% 和 6.67%(P = 0.011),相应的 30 天大出血率分别为 1.15%、1.84%、9.09% 和 13.33%(P = 0.002)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 先前存在的 ATT 用户有更大的合并症负担和更多的 重症登革热 表现。探索性监测表明阿司匹林使用者的血小板计数和功能恢复延迟。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为急性登革热感染期间已接受抗血栓治疗的患者的临床管理提供信息。它们还可以指导未来关于 ATT 对登革热患者血小板恢复影响的研究。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是观察性和回顾性的,可能会引入偏差并限制因果推断。由于研究设计和潜在的混杂因素,证据是中等的。

title: Metabolomic Approaches for the Identification of Non-Invasive Biomarkers in Dengue Infection: A Systematic Review
abstract: Dengue is a major mosquito-borne viral disease whose rapid progression from self-limiting fever to hemorrhagic or shock syndrome (DHF/DSS) remains difficult to predict using conventional clinical markers. Metabolomics offers a promising avenue for identifying non-invasive biomarkers of infection and severity, but the evidence remains scattered across biofluids and analytical platforms. This systematic review synthesized human metabolomic studies of dengue infection to characterize the biofluids, techniques, and metabolic signatures reported to date. Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, PubMed, ScienceDirect, and Web of Science were searched for studies applying NMR- or MS-based metabolomics to human dengue samples, screened against PECO criteria requiring a healthy-control or severity comparison group. Of 780 records identified, 17 studies met all eligibility criteria. Most studies (14/17) analyzed blood-derived matrices (serum, plasma, or whole blood), while three analyzed urine; no eligible study examined feces, saliva, tears, sweat, or cerebrospinal fluid. Across studies, three convergent patterns emerged with increasing disease severity: depletion of serotonin and related tryptophan-pathway metabolites, disturbance of glycerophospholipid and lysophospholipid classes, and elevation of markers of hepatic and lipid-metabolic stress (bile acids, VLDL/LDL changes, acylcarnitines). Serotonin combined with IFN-γ achieved the strongest discriminatory performance reported (AUC = 0.92) for progression to DHF, while urinary alkanes and betaine emerged as candidate non-invasive markers linked to infection status and comorbidities such as diabetes. These findings highlight a persistent reliance on blood-based sampling and a near-total absence of studies exploring alternative, more accessible biofluids, representing a clear gap for future non-invasive biomarker research in dengue.
